{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_duplicates = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_count = patient_duplicates.sum()

# Check how many unique patients and total rows
unique_patients = data['patient_id'].nunique()
total_rows = len(data)

print(f'Unique patients: {unique_patients}')
print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')
print(f'Duplicate patient entries: {dup_count}')

# Show how many times each patient appears
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f'Patients with >1 entry: {len(dup_patients)}')
print(dup_patients)"}
